(542 minutes) {{C|total}} |network=[[Cartoon Network]] |first aired=[[September 29]], [[2012]] |last aired=[[March 2]], [[2013]] |creators=[[George Lucas]] |writers= |directors= |executive producers= |production company= |starring= |timeline=[[20 BBY]]–[[19 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' |preceded by=[[The Clone Wars: Season Four|''The Clone Wars'': Season Four]] |followed by=[[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|''The Lost Missions'']] }} {{Quote|Some of the characters that we have created for the show will meet their destinies.|Dave Filoni|{{InsiderCite|134|Behind and Beyond the Battle Lines}}}} '''''The Clone Wars'': Season Five''' was the fifth season of the animated ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which debuted on [[September 29]], [[2012]]. The season was first confirmed to be in development in [[December]] [[2011]]. Unlike the series' four previous seasons, which aired on Friday nights in prime time at 9:00 p.m. ET, Season Five aired on Saturday mornings at 9:30 a.m. ET.{{WebCite|url=http://www.ign.com/articles/2012/08/25/star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-5-trailer-reveals-premiere-date-a-new-timeslot-and-an-awesome-sith-battle|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars - Season 5 Trailer Reveals Premiere Date, a New Timeslot and an Awesome Sith Battle!|author=Goldman, Eric|date=2012-08-24|quote=The end of the trailer also revealed both The Clone Wars premiere date and its new timeslot: Season 5 will premiere on September 29th, as the show moves from Friday nights to Saturday mornings at 9:30am.|archivedate=20161026230023}}{{WebCite|url=http://www.examiner.com/review/a-review-of-the-clone-wars-season-5-premiere|text=A review of The Clone Wars Season 5 premiere! - National Star Wars|author=Young, Bryan|date=2012-08-24|work=Examiner.com|quote=The Clone Wars is moving to a new time slot with that premiere: Saturday mornings at 9:30 am.|archivedate=20151031020617}} Also unlike previous seasons, Season Five consisted of only twenty episodes.{{WebCite|url=http://tvlistings.zap2it.com/tvlistings/ZCProgram.do?sId=EP01087361&t=Star+Wars%3A+The+Clone+Wars&method=getEpisodesForShow&desc=on|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|work=Zap2it|archivedate=20170120202320}}{{WebCite|url=http://www.teletoonmedia.com/en/index.php/teletoon/highlight/category/february_2013_programming_highlights|text=FEBRUARY 2013 PROGRAMMING HIGHLIGHTS|work=Teletoon|archivedate=20130104183445}} It was the final season of the series to be broadcast on [[Cartoon Network]]. Before it began airing, Hasbro suggested that Season Five would be the last season of ''The Clone Wars''.{{WebCite|url=http://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=10434|text=Hasbro Q And A - MORE Of Your Questions Answered!|author=Paul|archivedate=20171202073820}} Supervising Director Dave Filoni disputed this claim at the time,{{SW|url=news/100-episodes-of-the-clone-wars-a-reflection|text=100 Episodes of ''The Clone Wars'': A Reflection}} and in [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]], he reiterated his intention to keep making the series as long as people were watching. He also announced that his staff had begun working on scripts and designs for a sixth season.{{InsiderCite|137|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Cast and Crew on...}} However, the series was canceled after Season Five, with thirteen remaining episodes that had been in development being released as [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|The Lost Missions]] on [[March 7]], [[2014]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-lost-missions-now-on-netflix|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Lost Missions Now on Netflix|nolive=1}} In the fourteenth episode, "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]," Cartoon Network censored the scene when [[Savage Opress]] decapitates several [[Black Sun]] [[Black Sun ruling council/Legends|leaders]]. However, it was confirmed that the full scene would be visible on the Blu-ray edition of the series. A scene from "[[Shades of Reason]]" was also censored, when [[Darth]] [[Maul]] decapitates [[Pre Vizsla]], and his head rolls down on the stairs of the throne room of [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]]. ==Continuity== [[File:YodaMakeover-TCWs5BR2.png|thumb|right|400px|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] received an updated CG character model for Season Five (right)]] At one point, the "younglings arc" (i.e. "[[The Gathering (episode)|The Gathering]]," "[[A Test of Strength]]," "[[Bound for Rescue]]" and "[[A Necessary Bond]]") was considered as the pilot for a possible spin-off series.{{WebCite|url=http://www.cinemablend.com/television/1589720|text=The Last Star Wars Project George Lucas Considered Before Selling To Disney|author=Venable, Nick|date=2016-11-25|work=Cinema Blend|archivedate=20170802181114}} Under this plan,[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle (updated edition)|''Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle, Updated Edition'']] "[[A War on Two Fronts]]" was intended to be the Season Five premiere,{{InsiderCite|134|Launchpad}} though it was eventually changed to "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]],"{{InsiderCite|135|Launchpad}} with "A War on Two Fronts" becoming the second episode of the season. Following the episode order published in ''Insider'' 134, [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]] also reported the episodes through episode fifteen: {|{{Prettytable}} ! Episode !! Title |- |06 |"[[An Old Friend]]" |- |07 |"[[The Rise of Clovis]]" |- |08 |"[[Crisis at the Heart]]" |- |09{{InsiderCite|137|Launchpad|Launch Pad}} |"[[Secret Weapons]]" |- |10 |"[[A Sunny Day in the Void]]" |- |11 |"[[Missing in Action]]" |- |12 |"[[Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)|Point of No Return]]" |- |13 |"[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]" |- |14 |"[[Shades of Reason]]" |- |15 |"[[The Lawless]]" |} Following the printing of ''Star Wars Insider'' 137, a new airing order was released, beginning with the sixth episode, "[[The Gathering (episode)|The Gathering]]." [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed the release order inconsistencies through the official ''Star Wars'' blog.{{SW|url=news/whats-inside-star-wars-insider-137|text=What's Inside ''Star Wars Insider'' #137|nolive=1}} Furthermore, the episodes "[[An Old Friend]]," "[[The Rise of Clovis]]," and "[[Crisis at the Heart]]" were pushed to the series' [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]].{{InsiderCite|148|Launchpad|Launch Pad}} ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|soundcat=Audio files from The Clone Wars: Season Five|imagecat=Images from The Clone Wars: Season Five}} ===Episodes=== {|{{Prettytable}} !
